caption: The drawing depicts a single figure of a seated warrior dressed in classical armor and attire. The warrior is positioned on a rectangular block and appears to be deep in thought, with one elbow resting on their knee and their head supported by their hand. The armor includes detailed elements such as a breastplate, a helmet with decorative elements, greaves on the legs, and sandals. The warrior also wears a flowing cape draped over one shoulder and down the back, rendered in shades of brown and red. A round shield featuring an ornate design with gold and red accents leans against the figure's leg and the side of the block. The entire drawing is done in earth tones, primarily browns, with touches of muted gold, red, and green for details on the armor and accessories. The background is plain and light-colored, emphasizing the figure's form and attire. A small monogram and the letters "INN" appear in the lower right corner of the paper.
title: Seated Warrior
